description: This file implements a React component for handling Paddle checkout process within the Notesnook project, including creating checkouts, applying coupons, handling events, and rendering an iframe for payment.

methods.name: PaddleCheckout
methods.description: React component managing Paddle checkout flow, event handling, and iframe rendering.

methods.name: getCheckoutURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the Paddle checkout iframe based on checkout ID and theme.

methods.name: getPricingInfo
methods.description: Extracts and formats pricing information from checkout data and options.

methods.name: getCheckoutSettings
methods.description: Generates checkout settings object based on theme.

methods.name: createCheckout
methods.description: Creates a new checkout session via API, including customer info and applying coupons.

methods.name: submitCustomerInfo
methods.description: Submits customer address and email info to the checkout API.

methods.name: applyCoupon
methods.description: Applies a discount coupon to an existing checkout.

methods.name: removeDiscount
methods.description: Removes a discount from an existing checkout.
